Subject: Hosted API usage + renewal (Nov)

Marcus,

Thanks for the chat earlier. Parcelify is ready to move forward with a renewal but with a material uplift: we want to increase our hosted API monthly commit from 2,000,000 tokens to 5,000,000 tokens starting Jan 1. Key asks:

- Pricing: can you confirm blended unit price at that volume and any escalator over 12 months?
- Burst: we need a 20% burst window for seasonal spikes (Black Friday carryover).
- Soft throttle: procurement asked that we keep a soft throttle before hard rejects — they want clear fallback/notifications.
- Contract term: 12 months preferred, willing to discuss a 24-month option for deeper discount.

Can you send a short options doc and a proposed mutual action plan? Procurement (cc'd in my follow-up) will need billing contact information for PO and DocuSign.

Thanks — Olivia

Olivia Chen

olivia@parcelify.com

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T12:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API usage + renewal (Nov)

Olivia — really appreciate the clarity. Attaching a short options packet (renewal-options-parcelify.pdf) with three approaches:

1) Standard 12-mo uplift: 5M/mo commit, 10% volume discount, 20% seasonal burst credit (billed monthly as overage allowance). Soft throttle at 95% of commit with 24h notification.
2) 24-mo locked: 5M/mo commit, 16% volume discount, larger burst pocket (30%), prorated implementation credits. SLA uplift available at this tier.
3) Phased ladder: Start 3.5M for 3 months -> 5M thereafter. Lower initial price point with a one-time onboarding credit.

Operational notes: we recommend the phased ladder if you want to reduce upfront spend while smoothing capacity changes. We will include a canary rollout window (two weeks) to catch KV-cache migrations and model runner warmups.

Next steps: I can send a mutual action plan and a DocuSign package for the option you pick. Are you available for a 30-min call Thurs 11/26 at 11am PT to finalize?

Attachments: renewal-options-parcelify.pdf (3 pages)

— Marcus Lin
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T08:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API usage + renewal (Nov) — ops notes (internal)

Internal ops notes for the record: Parcelify's ask is straightforward but we should lock the following to avoid surprise throttles during their Black Friday test: 

- Implement soft throttle threshold at 95% of commit with an exponential backoff notification to the caller (15 sec, 1 min, 5 min) and a configurable route-based fallback to a lower-capacity variant.
- Reserve a burst pool equal to 20% of commit for scheduled seasonal windows; allow unused burst to roll into a one-time monthly credit (max 50% of pool).
- Canary plan: run 5% of traffic against new commit profile for 7 days, monitor token-per-request distribution and latencies (p95/p99).
- Billing/proration: if start date != first of month, bill pro-rata on committed units and apply onboarding credit as a negative line item.

I attached a quick MOP (mop-parcelify-20261126.xlsx) template we can pre-fill for procurement. Jordan — can you confirm whether the burst pool will be enforced per-tenant or per-organization? I think per-tenant is safer for their use case.

— Kimberly
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Highlights: 
- Start: 3.5M/month (Jan, Feb, Mar) -> 5.0M/month from Apr 1 onward.
- Pricing: blended effective discount 13% across year 1 under this ladder, with an additional 2% for an executed PO + 24-month term.
- Burst: 20% burst pool with soft throttle at 95%; unused burst converts to one-time credit as Kimberly outlined.
- Canary: 7-day 5% traffic canary, monitoring p95/p99 latency and token distribution.
- Billing: prorated first month; onboarding credit applied on first invoice.

Action items I’ve included in the MAP: procurement signs PO, DocuSign signature on SOW, ops confirms canary window schedule, finance approves billing contact. DocuSign link here: https://www.docusign.com/templates/XYZ-Parcelify-2026
